title: Crosschain Smart Contract Risk Analyer
tagline: Preventing non-security crypto users from investing in vulnerable tokens across chains

description:
The biggest problem in web3 security is the lack of knowledge and understanding. Hence I am creating a simple easy to understand risk score between 1 to 100 that can help people to understand if a smart contract is secured or vulnerable. It is backed by complex tools like slither, mythrill etc. and also AI based scoring that is trained with vulnerable smart contracts and has the intelligence to identify risks. 

Also created a CHATGPT model to have a conversational experience for common users. Here is the demo - https://youtu.be/I2twJA5MgqA
